khmer: គួរឲ្យស្ដាយ
breakdown: 可(worth)+惜(cherish, regret) — worth regretting

examples.en: It's a pity he can't come.

examples.cn: 这么好的机会，放弃了很可惜。
examples.py: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì, fàngqì le hěn kěxī.
examples.en: Such a good chance, a pity to give it up.

examples.cn: 可惜下雨了，不能去爬山。
examples.py: Kěxī xià yǔ le, bù néng qù páshān.
examples.en: Unfortunately it rained, so we can't hike.

examples.py: Dōngxi hái néng yòng, rēng le kěxī.
examples.en: It still works, a pity to throw it away.

khmer: បន្ទប់ទទួលភ្ញៀវ
breakdown: 客(guest)+厅(hall) — the hall for guests

examples.en: There's a sofa in the living room.
We chat in the living room.
The living room is very clean.
Please sit in the living room.

examples.py: Kètīng de jiājù shì xīn de.
examples.en: The living room furniture is new.

breakdown: 肯(be willing, agree)+定(fixed) — agreed and fixed

examples.py: Lǎoshī kěndìng le wǒ de xiǎngfǎ.

breakdown: 穴(cave)+工 — an empty hollow; read kòng for free time, kōng for empty

examples.en: I have no free time today.

examples.py: Yǒu kòng wǒmen yìqǐ chīfàn ba.
examples.en: Let's eat together when you're free.

examples.py: Qǐng zài kòng de dìfang xiě míngzi.
examples.en: Please write your name in the blank space.

khmer: ខ្យល់អាកាស
breakdown: 空(empty, sky)+气(gas, air) — the gas in the sky

examples.py: Chéngshì de kōngqì bú tài hǎo.

examples.en: Please open the window to change the air.

examples.py: Wūrǎn ràng kōngqì biàn chà le.

khmer: ខ្លាចក្រែង
breakdown: 恐(fear)+怕(fear) — two fear characters, used to soften bad news

examples.en: I'm afraid it's going to rain.
I'm afraid we won't make it.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì kǒngpà hěn nán jiějué.
examples.en: I'm afraid this is hard to solve.

examples.py: Kǒngpà wǒ bù néng cānjiā le.

khmer: ល្វីង / លំបាក
breakdown: 艹(grass radical)+古(sound gǔ) — a bitter plant

examples.en: His life as a child was hard.
The medicine is bitter but useful.
Only through hardship can you succeed.

breakdown: 矿(mineral)+泉(spring)+水(water) — water from a mineral spring

examples.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì píng kuàngquánshuǐ.
examples.en: Please give me a bottle of mineral water.
The mineral water is in the fridge.

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng píng kuàngquánshuǐ.
examples.en: I bought two bottles of mineral water.

examples.cn: 运动的时候要带矿泉水。
examples.py: Yùndòng de shíhou yào dài kuàngquánshuǐ.

examples.cn: 这个矿泉水的价格很低。
examples.py: Zhège kuàngquánshuǐ de jiàgé hěn dī.
examples.en: This mineral water's price is low.

breakdown: 囗(enclosure)+木(tree) — a tree boxed in, feeling stuck and sleepy

examples.en: Go to sleep when you're sleepy.

examples.py: Shàngkè de shíhou tā hěn kùn.
Hē kāfēi yǐhòu jiù bú kùn le.

breakdown: 困(stuck)+难(hard) — stuck and hard

examples.en: Don't give up when facing difficulties.

examples.py: Tā jīnglì le hěn duō kùnnan.

examples.en: If you have difficulties you can find me.

breakdown: 垃圾(rubbish)+桶(bucket) — a bucket for rubbish

examples.en: The bin is by the door.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ lājī rēng jìn lājītǒng.
examples.en: Please throw the rubbish in the bin.

examples.py: Chúfáng lǐ yǒu yí ge lājītǒng.
examples.en: There's a bin in the kitchen.

breakdown: 扌(hand radical)+立(stand) — a hand pulling

examples.py: Tā lā zhe wǒ de gēbo.
Zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng, lā bu dòng.
examples.en: This box is too heavy to pull.

examples.py: Māma lā zhe háizi de shǒu.

breakdown: 辛(bitter, pungent)+束 — a pungent, sharp taste

examples.py: Là de dōngxi duì dùzi bù hǎo.
examples.en: Spicy things are bad for the stomach.

examples.py: Tài là le, wǒ yào hē shuǐ.
examples.en: It's too spicy, I need water.

english: there isn't enough time; too late
khmer: មិនទាន់ពេល
breakdown: 来(come)+不(not)+及(reach) — cannot reach it in time

examples.py: Kuài diǎn, lái bu jí le.
Wǒ lái bu jí chī zǎofàn.
examples.en: I don't have time for breakfast.

examples.cn: 现在出发已经来不及了。
examples.py: Xiànzài chūfā yǐjīng lái bu jí le.
examples.en: Leaving now is already too late.
There's no time left to review.

examples.cn: 因为堵车，我来不及赶飞机。
examples.py: Yīnwèi dǔchē, wǒ lái bu jí gǎn fēijī.
examples.en: Because of traffic I can't make the flight.

english: there is still time; can make it
breakdown: 来(come)+得(able)+及(reach) — able to reach it in time

examples.py: Xiànzài chūfā lái de jí ma?
examples.en: Can we make it if we leave now?

examples.py: Xiànzài gǎibiàn hái lái de jí.
examples.en: It's not too late to change now.

breakdown: 来(come)+自(from) — coming from

examples.py: Tā láizì yí ge xiǎo chéngshì.
examples.en: He comes from a small city.

examples.cn: 这些学生来自很多国家。
examples.py: Zhèxiē xuésheng láizì hěn duō guójiā.
examples.en: These students come from many countries.
This news comes from the Internet.

breakdown: 忄(heart radical)+赖 — a heart that won't move

examples.py: Bié tài lǎn, qǐlái duànliàn ba.
examples.en: Don't be lazy, get up and exercise.
I'm a bit lazy on weekends.

examples.py: Lǎn de rén hěn nán chénggōng.

examples.en: He can't be bothered to cook.

breakdown: 浪(wave, loose, 氵water radical)+费(spend) — spending like water

examples.en: This is a waste of time.

examples.py: Tā làngfèi le hěn duō qián.
examples.en: He wasted a lot of money.

breakdown: 浪(wave)+漫(free, overflowing) — free and flowing feelings

examples.py: Zhè shì yí ge làngmàn de dìfang.

examples.cn: 他准备了一个浪漫的晚饭。
examples.py: Tā zhǔnbèi le yí ge làngmàn de wǎnfàn.

breakdown: 老(prefix for animals)+虎(tiger) — the tiger

examples.en: There are tigers in the zoo.
The child is afraid of tigers.

khmer: ស្ងប់ស្ងាត់
breakdown: 冷(cold)+静(still) — cold and still, not hot-headed

examples.cn: 冷静下来才能考虑清楚。
examples.py: Lěngjìng xiàlái cái néng kǎolǜ qīngchu.
examples.en: Only when calm can you think clearly.

examples.py: Tā lěngjìng de jiějué le wèntí.

khmer: ថ្ងៃអាទិត្យ
breakdown: 礼拜(worship, week)+天(day) — the worship day of the week
礼(courtesy)+貌(appearance) — the appearance of courtesy

examples.py: Dǎ zhāohu shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.en: Greeting people is a form of politeness.

examples.py: Lǐmào kěyǐ ràng rén xǐhuan nǐ.

breakdown: 理(arrange, tidy)+发(hair) — tidying the hair

examples.en: I need to get a haircut.

examples.py: Wǒ měi ge yuè lǐ yí cì fà.
examples.en: I get a haircut once a month.

breakdown: 理(reason)+解(untie) — untying the reason

examples.en: This question is hard to understand.

examples.py: Fùmǔ bù lǐjiě wǒ de xuǎnzé.
examples.en: My parents don't understand my choice.

breakdown: 理(reason)+想(think) — what reason and thought aim at

examples.py: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì dāng lǎoshī.
examples.en: My dream is to be a teacher.

examples.py: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng.
Zhè bú shì lǐxiǎng de jiéguǒ.

examples.en: You must work hard for your dreams.

examples.py: Zhè shì yí ge lǐxiǎng de dìdiǎn.

breakdown: 力(force)+气(energy) — force and energy

examples.cn: 我没有力气搬这个箱子。
examples.py: Wǒ méiyǒu lìqi bān zhège xiāngzi.
examples.en: I don't have the strength to move this box.

examples.py: Chī bǎo le cái yǒu lìqi.
examples.en: Only when full do you have strength.
Moving house takes a lot of strength.

examples.py: Shēngbìng yǐhòu tā méi lìqi le.
examples.en: After being sick he had no strength.

khmer: ខ្លាំង / ពូកែ
breakdown: 厉(strict, severe)+害(harm) — strong to the point of being fierce

examples.cn: 这个老师很厉害，学生都怕他。
examples.py: Zhège lǎoshī hěn lìhai, xuésheng dōu pà tā.
examples.en: This teacher is strict, students fear him.

khmer: ឧទាហរណ៍ដូចជា
breakdown: 例(example)+如(like) — like this example

examples.en: I like fruit, for example bananas.

examples.py: Lìrú zhège fāngfǎ jiù hěn hǎo.
examples.en: For example, this method is good.

examples.cn: 很多运动，例如打球和游泳。
examples.py: Hěn duō yùndòng, lìrú dǎ qiú hé yóuyǒng.
examples.en: Many sports, for example ball games and swimming.
For example, we can take the subway.

examples.py: Qǐng jǔ yí ge lìrú de qíngkuàng.

breakdown: 亻(person radical)+两(two) — two persons

examples.en: The two of us are good friends.
The two of them look alike.

examples.cn: 我们俩一起完成了任务。
examples.py: Wǒmen liǎ yìqǐ wánchéng le rènwu.
examples.en: The two of us finished the task together.
Just the two of us, nobody else.

breakdown: 辶(walking radical)+车(vehicle) — vehicles linked in a line

examples.py: Tā lián fàn dōu méi chī.
Wǒ lián zhège zì dōu bú rènshi.
examples.en: I don't even know this character.

examples.py: Lián háizi dōu dǒng zhège dàolǐ.
Tā lián zhe gōngzuò le sān tiān.
examples.en: He worked three days in a row.

examples.py: Lián tā dōu bù zhīdào dá'àn.
examples.en: Even he doesn't know the answer.

breakdown: 联(join, 耳ear radical)+系(tie) — joining and tying together

examples.py: Wǒmen hěn jiǔ méi liánxì le.
examples.en: We haven't been in touch for a long time.

examples.py: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì yǒu liánxì.
Wǒ yòng duǎnxìn gēn tā liánxì.
examples.en: I contact him by text message.

khmer: ត្រជាក់ស្រួល
breakdown: 凉(cool)+快(pleasant) — pleasantly cool

examples.py: Kāi kōngtiáo fángjiān jiù liángkuai le.
examples.en: With the AC on the room got cool.

breakdown: 零(zero, fraction)+钱(money) — the small fraction of money

examples.en: You need change for the bus.

examples.py: Língqián zài wǒ de qiánbāo lǐ.
examples.en: The change is in my wallet.

examples.cn: 用手机付款就不用零钱了。
examples.py: Yòng shǒujī fùkuǎn jiù búyòng língqián le.
examples.en: Paying by phone means no change needed.

breakdown: 另(another)+外(outside) — another one outside this

examples.py: Lìngwài hái yǒu yí ge wèntí.
Wǒ xiǎng mǎi lìngwài yí ge.
examples.en: I want to buy another one.

examples.py: Lìngwài de fāngfǎ kěnéng gèng hǎo.
Wǒmen lìngwài zhǎo yí ge dìdiǎn.

english: to stay; to keep; to leave (behind)
khmer: ស្នាក់នៅ / ទុក
breakdown: 卯+田(field) — staying on the land

examples.py: Qǐng liú xià nǐ de hàomǎ.
Tā liú zài le zhège chéngshì.
Gěi wǒ liú yí fèn ba.
examples.en: Please keep a portion for me.

examples.cn: 这段回忆我会一直留着。
examples.py: Zhè duàn huíyì wǒ huì yìzhí liú zhe.
Tā liú le yì zhāng zhǐtiáo.

khmer: ស្ទាត់ជំនាញ
breakdown: 流(flow, 氵water radical)+利(smooth, sharp) — flowing smoothly

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng shuō de gèng liúlì.
examples.en: I want to speak more fluently.

examples.py: Tā liúlì de huídá le wèntí.

breakdown: 流(flow)+行(go around) — flowing around among people

examples.en: This color is popular this year.

examples.py: Zhè zhǒng yīfu xiànzài hěn liúxíng.
examples.en: This kind of clothing is popular now.

examples.py: Liúxíng de dōngxi biànhuà hěn kuài.

examples.cn: 这个游戏在年轻人中很流行。
examples.py: Zhège yóuxì zài niánqīng rén zhōng hěn liúxíng.
examples.en: This game is popular among young people.

khmer: ធ្វើដំណើរកម្សាន្ត
breakdown: 旅(journey)+行(go) — going on a journey

examples.cn: 旅行可以了解不同的文化。
examples.py: Lǚxíng kěyǐ liǎojiě bùtóng de wénhuà.
examples.en: Travel lets you learn different cultures.
You need a passport to travel.

breakdown: 律(law)+师(master, professional) — a professional of law

examples.en: I need a lawyer to help.
Lawyers know a lot of law.

examples.py: Dāng lǜshī yào xué hěn duō nián.
examples.en: Becoming a lawyer takes many years of study.

examples.py: Lǜshī bāng wǒ jiějué le wèntí.
examples.en: The lawyer helped me solve the problem.

khmer: រំខាន / រញ៉េរញ៉ៃ
breakdown: 麻(hemp, tangled)+烦(annoyed) — as tangled as hemp

examples.en: Could I trouble you to help me?

examples.py: Wǒ bù xiǎng gěi nǐ tiān máfan.
examples.en: I don't want to cause you trouble.

examples.cn: 这个表格填起来很麻烦。
examples.py: Zhège biǎogé tián qǐlái hěn máfan.
examples.en: This form is troublesome to fill in.

khmer: ធ្វេសប្រហែស
breakdown: 马(horse)+虎(tiger) — from a story of drawing something between a horse and tiger

examples.py: Kǎoshì de shíhou bù néng mǎhu.
examples.en: You can't be careless during an exam.

examples.py: Tā mǎhu de xiě wán le zuòyè.

breakdown: 氵(water radical)+满 — water filled to the top

examples.py: Cāntīng lǐ zuò mǎn le rén.
examples.en: The restaurant is full of people.
His face is covered in sweat.

examples.py: Qǐng bié dào de tài mǎn.
examples.en: Please don't pour it too full.

breakdown: A picture of a tuft of hair or fur

examples.py: Zhège māo de máo hěn ruǎn.
examples.en: This cat's fur is very soft.

examples.py: Máoyī shì yòng yángmáo zuò de.
Lǎohǔ de máo shì huángsè de.

breakdown: 毛(fur, fluffy)+巾(cloth) — a fluffy cloth

examples.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì tiáo máojīn.

examples.en: Wipe your face with a towel.
The towel is in the bathroom.

examples.py: Yùndòng de shíhou yào dài máojīn.

khmer: ស្រស់ស្អាត
breakdown: 美(beautiful)+丽(lovely) — two beauty characters together

examples.cn: 她是一个美丽的女孩儿。
examples.py: Tā shì yí ge měilì de nǚháir.
Zhè shì yí ge měilì de chéngshì.
Zhè shì yí duàn měilì de huíyì.

breakdown: 林(forest)+夕(evening) — the dark forest of the evening mind

examples.py: Wǒ zuótiān zuò le yí ge mèng.
Zhè shì yí ge qíguài de mèng.
Tā de mèng shì dāng yīshēng.
examples.en: His dream is to be a doctor.

examples.py: Mèng lǐ de shì dōu bú shì zhēn de.
Zhù nǐ yǒu ge hǎo mèng.

khmer: វង្វេងផ្លូវ
breakdown: 迷(confused, 辶walking radical)+路(road) — confused about the road

examples.en: Without a map it's easy to get lost.

examples.py: Tā zài chéngshì lǐ mílù le.
examples.en: He got lost in the city.

examples.cn: 迷路的时候可以问警察。
examples.py: Mílù de shíhou kěyǐ wèn jǐngchá.
examples.en: When lost you can ask the police.

examples.py: Wǒmen mílù le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: We were lost for two hours.

khmer: លេខសម្ងាត់
breakdown: 密(secret)+码(code) — a secret code

examples.cn: 银行卡的密码不能告诉别人。
examples.py: Yínháng kǎ de mìmǎ bù néng gàosu biéren.
examples.en: Don't tell anyone your bank card password.

breakdown: 禾(grain radical)+少(few) — a tiny amount of time

examples.en: It was only two seconds short.

examples.cn: 比赛的最后几秒很紧张。
examples.py: Bǐsài de zuìhòu jǐ miǎo hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: The last few seconds of the match were tense.
